### In Times of Blessing
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/in-times-of-blessing1
Passage: Psalm 149:1-3
Points:
- Seasons of abundance, health, and peace should prompt spontaneous thanksgiving.
- Singing a new song expresses fresh, heartfelt joy rather than stale routine.
- Gathering with other believers to celebrate God's goodness strengthens communal worship.
- Earthly blessings and promotion come from God and should be received without guilt.
- Praise in times of blessing should be joyful, demonstrative, and unrestrained.

### Our Duty to Rejoice in Our King
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/our-duty-rejoice-our-king
Passage: Psalm 149:1-9
Points:
- Scripture commands God's people to rejoice in their King as a duty.
- God graciously turns religious duties from mere drudgery into genuine delights.
- Joy is grounded in the reality that God takes pleasure in His people.
- Believers are granted the dignity of participating in the King's victorious work.
- Contemplating God's grace helps believers cultivate sincere, willing praise even when feelings lag.
